quests.title: The Road West
quests.description:
Outrider Bram Tolliver rides the road west from Crown Guard to the river, and he's the only one who does it regularly. The Plague Hounds hunt along it in packs, and the Frenzied Ghouls come out of the ditches when they hear horses.

He wants the road safe enough for someone other than him.
quests.accept_text: West from Crown Guard, along the old road toward the river. The hounds run the open ground and the ghouls hide in the ditches. Don't stop moving, because they'll swarm you.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's a road a wagon could use again.

The newcomers at the chapel keep asking me why I ride it alone. I tell them it's because nobody else is daft enough.

quests.title: Corin's Crossing
quests.description:
Corin's Crossing was a crossroads town until the Cult took it over. Now it's where the plague carts load up. The Cult Plaguebringers fill the barrels and the Cult Cart Drivers take them out to the farms that are still alive.

Bram wants the crossing shut down.
quests.accept_text: West along the road from Crown Guard, where the roads cross. The plaguebringers are at the barrels in the square and the drivers are with the carts. Kill the plaguebringers first, because they'll throw the barrels.
quests.turn_in_text:
No carts left the crossing today. That's the first day in a year.

One of the drivers had papers on him, and I'd like you to see them.

quests.title: The Manifest
quests.description: The Cult Cart Drivers carry manifests that say where every barrel of plague is going. Bram wants one, so the Dawn can warn the farms on it before the carts get there.
quests.accept_text: Find a driver at the crossing and take his manifest off him. It'll be in his coat. Bring it back as fast as you can, because those carts don't wait.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are all farms in Lordaeron that are still alive, and some in the hills past it.

I'll have riders out to every one of them by nightfall. You've saved lives today, whether you see them or not.

quests.title: The Crossing's Abominations
quests.description:
The Cult brought in Crossing Abominations to guard the carts after the drivers started dying. They stand in the square at Corin's Crossing and they don't move unless something comes near.

Bram wants them brought down before the Cult can use them again.
quests.accept_text: They stand in the square at the crossing, around the carts. They're slow and they hit like a falling barn. Pull them one at a time if you can.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's the crossing's muscle gone.

There's only one man left running the carts, and I know exactly where he sleeps.

quests.title: Cartmaster Corin
quests.description:
Cartmaster Corin gave the crossing its name. He ran a carting business there before the plague, and now he runs it for the Cult, with the same ledgers and the same smile.

Bram wants him dead and his ledgers burned.
quests.accept_text: He's in the old counting house at the crossing. He doesn't fight fair and he'll call everything nearby to help. Take friends with you.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then the carts stop for good. I'll burn the counting house myself tonight.

I bought horses off him once, you know. He gave me a fair price.

quests.title: The Marris Stead
quests.description:
Edda Marris married into the Marris family two summers before the plague, and she was in town the day it reached the farm. She came home to find everyone dead and still working. The Marris Farmhands still walk the fields, and the Stead Crows pick at them.

She wants them put to rest.
quests.accept_text: The Marris Stead is south of the road, toward Terrordale. The farmhands work the fields and the crows follow them. They were good people, and they'd want it quick.
quests.turn_in_text:
Thank you. I've wanted that done for a long time, and I couldn't do it myself.

One of them always wore a locket. I'd give anything to have it back.

quests.title: The Marris Locket
quests.description: Edda's sister-in-law wore a brass locket with a painting of the whole family inside. She's still wearing it, out in the fields with the other Marris Farmhands. Edda wants it back.
quests.accept_text: She'll be one of the farmhands in the fields at the stead. It's a little brass locket on a chain. You'll know it when you see it.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's them, all of them. That's the summer before everything.

I'm not in it. I hadn't married in yet. There's one more of them out there, though, and he's the worst to think about.

quests.title: Old Marris
quests.description: Old Marris was the head of the family, a stubborn man who built the farm with his own hands. He still walks it, still giving orders to the dead. Edda wants him to rest with the others.
quests.accept_text: He's in the farmhouse, or in the barn behind it. He's strong, because he always was. Take friends if you can, and be kind to him if you can't.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then they're all at rest. The farm can go back to being a farm.

I think I'll go back there in the spring and plant something. He'd have liked that.

quests.title: The Fungal Vale
quests.description:
Dr. Sun Li studied fungi at a university in Kunming, back home, and the Fungal Vale is the most frightening thing she's ever seen. Something is growing there, and the Vale Plague Slimes and the Spore-Walkers are spreading it.

She wants them thinned before it spreads further.
quests.accept_text: The vale's north of the crossing, along the road toward Stratholme. The slimes crawl on the ground and the walkers drift between the caps. Don't breathe the spores, and keep your mouth shut.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's slowed it down, I think. It's hard to tell with fungus.

I need samples, if you'll go back, and I want them fresh.

quests.title: Spore Caps
quests.description: The Spore-Walkers in the Fungal Vale grow caps on their shoulders, and Sun Li thinks the caps are where the plague is changing. She wants them, cut fresh.
quests.accept_text: Cut the caps off the walkers in the vale. Put them in the sacks I gave you and tie them tight. If one starts to puff, drop it and don't look back.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are breathing. They're actually breathing.

It's not one fungus, it's dozens growing together. Something at the middle of the vale is holding them together.

quests.title: The Fungal Mass
quests.description: At the heart of the Fungal Vale there's something Sun Li can only call a mass, a fungus the size of a house that moves when it wants to. The Fungal Mass is what's feeding the rest. She wants it killed.
quests.accept_text: It sits in the middle of the vale and it'll come at you when you get close. It's huge and it's poisonous. Take friends and take antidotes.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's really dead? Then the vale will start dying back in a week.

That was the strangest organism I've ever studied, and I'm glad it's gone.

quests.title: Spores for the Sanctuary
quests.description:
Sun Li has sealed a sample of the Fungal Vale's spores in wax, and she knows a botanist at the Emerald Sanctuary in Felwood, Yuki Hashimoto, who's cataloguing everything that grows back in corrupted ground.

She wants the sample in Yuki's hands, so they can compare.

objectives.label: Bring Sun Li's spore sample to Yuki Hashimoto at the Emerald Sanctuary

quests.accept_text: Zeppelin from Tirisfal to Orgrimmar, then north through Ashenvale to Felwood. Yuki's at the Sanctuary, probably on her knees in a flowerbed. Don't break the wax.
quests.turn_in_text:
From Dr. Sun? I read her papers at university, back home.

The corruption here makes things grow back wrong, and these spores are doing the same thing. I'll write to her tonight.

on_accept.name: Sealed Spore Sample
on_accept.description: A glass jar sealed in red wax, with something grey and soft growing on the inside of the glass.

quests.title: Terrordale
quests.description:
Gravewarden Osric Vey keeps the Argent Dawn's dead, and Terrordale is full of dead nobody's kept. The Terrordale Ghouls hunt the hills and the Terrordale Spirits wail over them.

He wants the valley quieter.
quests.accept_text: Terrordale is in the south west, past the Marris Stead. The ghouls hunt the valley floor and the spirits drift along the hills. Stay out of the spirits' reach, because they'll drain you.
quests.turn_in_text:
I felt that from here. The valley's quieter tonight.

There's worse in Terrordale, though. The ones who raise the dead are still there.

quests.title: The Skeletal Mages
quests.description:
Terrordale's dead don't stay down because the Terrordale Skeletal Mages raise them again every night. They were Kirin Tor mages once, Osric thinks, sent to fight the plague and lost to it.

He wants them destroyed.
quests.accept_text: They stand among the dead in Terrordale, raising them. Kill them quickly, because they'll raise anything you kill around them.
quests.turn_in_text:
No more risings in Terrordale. Thank the Light.

The thing that rules that valley is still there, though, and it's what made them.

quests.title: The Terror of the Dale
quests.description: Terrordale is named for what lives in it. The Terror of the Dale was a lich's apprentice who stayed behind when the lich moved north, and it's held the valley ever since. Osric wants it ended.
quests.accept_text: It holds the ruined chapel in the middle of Terrordale. It's a caster, and it'll freeze you if you let it. Take friends, and keep moving.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then Terrordale belongs to nobody, and it can rest.

I'll write what happened there and send it west. There's someone across the sea who needs to read it.

quests.title: Word for Sun Rock
quests.description:
Osric has heard from the Forsaken that the dead are rising in Mulgore, across the sea, with nobody calling them. A tauren spiritwalker at Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon, Tohana, is trying to understand why. Osric has written down everything he knows about Terrordale.

He wants his account in Tohana's hands.

objectives.label: Bring Osric's account of Terrordale to Spiritwalker Tohana at Sun Rock

quests.accept_text: Zeppelin from Tirisfal to Orgrimmar, and a wind rider to Sun Rock. Tohana's the spiritwalker by the fire. Give it to Tohana and nobody else.
quests.turn_in_text:
From the Plaguelands? From a gravewarden of the Dawn?

The spirits in Mulgore are restless the same way, like something's calling them and they don't know where from. This helps more than you know. Tell him the earth thanks him.

on_accept.name: Osric's Account
on_accept.description: A long letter in a gravewarden's careful hand, sealed with the Dawn's sunburst.

quests.title: Crow Pie
quests.description: Greta's grandmother made crow pie, and the Stead Crows at the Marris Stead are the fattest crows Greta has ever seen. She wants to make it for the camp, whether the camp likes it or not.
quests.accept_text: The crows follow the farmhands at the Marris Stead, south of the road. Get the fat ones. Don't tell anyone what's in the pie until after they've had seconds.
quests.turn_in_text:
Look at the size of them! That's a pie for the whole camp.

The newcomers will eat it and ask what it was. I'll tell them it's chicken, and they'll believe me.

quests.title: Gargoyles over the Road
quests.description:
Ser Roland Ashcombe keeps the Argent Dawn's watch on Stratholme, and the Stone-Winged Gargoyles keep watching him back. They fly over the road from the city and dive on anyone who looks too long.

Roland wants the sky over the road cleared.
quests.accept_text: They circle over the road north of the crossing, toward Stratholme. They'll turn to stone if they're hurt, so finish them quickly. Don't let them get above you.
quests.turn_in_text:
I can see the road again without a gargoyle in the way.

The gate's a different matter, and that's where the real work is.

quests.title: The Gates of Stratholme
quests.description:
Stratholme's gates are held by Gate Death Knights and the Gate Gargoyles that perch over them. Roland was a knight of Lordaeron, and some of those death knights were his brothers in arms.

He wants the gates thinned, so the Dawn can get close enough to see inside.
quests.accept_text: Follow the road north past the Fungal Vale and west through Plaguewood. The gates are at the end of it. The death knights don't retreat, so pick them off one at a time.
quests.turn_in_text:
I knew some of those men. I'll pray for them, the ones I recognised.

There's one left at the gate who holds it, and he's the one I want.

quests.title: Gatekeeper Vorthas
quests.description:
Gatekeeper Vorthas was a captain of Stratholme's guard, and he held the gate when the city fell. He holds it still, for the Scourge now. Roland served under him.

He wants his old captain at rest.
quests.accept_text: He stands at Stratholme's gate, where he always stood. He's a death knight now, and he's strong. Take friends, and don't fight him alone.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then he's at rest. I hope he knows that I'm sorry.

He taught me how to hold a shield. Every one of us who served under him owes you for this.

quests.title: Sigils of the Fallen
quests.description: The Gate Death Knights still wear the sigils of the knightly houses they served when they were alive. Roland wants them back, so the houses that are left can know what happened to their sons and daughters.
quests.accept_text: The death knights at Stratholme's gate wear the sigils on their breastplates. Cut them off and bring them here. I'll know every house by its colours.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's Barov, and that's Mardenholde, and this one's my own cousin's house.

I'll write to every family that's left. It's the least they deserve, and it's more than most of them will get.

quests.title: Plaguewood
quests.description:
Huntress Kaia Lindgren hunted reindeer in the north of Norway before the Integration, and now she hunts for Light's Hope. Plaguewood's the worst hunting ground she's ever seen. The Plaguewood Spiders spin their webs across every path, and the Plaguewood Crypt Fiends dig under them.

She wants them cleared.
quests.accept_text: Plaguewood's north and west of the crossing, on the road to Stratholme. The spiders are in the trees and the fiends are underground. Watch where you step, because they come up underneath you.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's some ugly hunting. Thank you for doing it with me.

I was a reindeer herder outside Tromso, back home. I never thought I'd miss the cold.

quests.title: Plaguewood Silk
quests.description: Kaia makes her own snares, and the Plaguewood Spiders spin silk that's stronger than any rope in the Plaguelands. She wants enough of it to rig snares around the whole chapel.
quests.accept_text: The spiders in Plaguewood carry silk in their glands. Cut it out carefully, because it sticks to everything. Wear gloves if you've got them.
quests.turn_in_text:
This is beautiful silk. I'll have snares around the chapel by the weekend.

There's a big one in Plaguewood, the mother of all of them. I'd like to see her gone.

quests.title: The Plaguewood Matriarch
quests.description:
Every spider in Plaguewood came from the same nest, and the thing that laid them still sits in it. Kaia calls her the Plaguewood Matriarch, and she's bigger than a horse.

Kaia wants her dead.
quests.accept_text: She's in the deepest part of Plaguewood, where the webs are thickest. She's fast and she's poisonous. Take friends, and bring a knife for the webs.
quests.turn_in_text:
She's really dead? Then Plaguewood will empty out in a season.

I'll make you a snare from her silk, if you like. It'd hold a dragon.

quests.title: Carrion Grubs
quests.description:
The Carrion Grubs eat everything that dies on the road west, and then they eat everything that's alive and slow. Kaia's lost a dozen snares to them.

She wants them gone.
quests.accept_text: They swarm the road and the ditches beside it. They're slow and they're soft, but there are always more. Burn them if you can.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's the road clear of them for a while, anyway.

Thank you. I'd rather hunt anything else in the world than those.

quests.title: Hound Fangs
quests.description:
Kaia's run out of arrowheads, and the Plague Hounds on the road west have fangs as hard as flint. She's been knapping them into points, and they fly true.

She wants more fangs.
quests.accept_text: The hounds run in packs along the road west from Crown Guard. Pull the big canines, the ones at the front. I'll do the rest by the fire.
quests.turn_in_text:
These are perfect. I'll have a quiver full by tomorrow night.

My grandfather made fishhooks from bone, back home. I didn't think I'd ever need to know how.

quests.title: A Look at Stratholme
quests.description:
Dawnbringer has never seen Stratholme since it fell, and he won't send the Dawn in until someone has. He wants you to walk to the city's gate and look at it.

Just look, he says. Then come back.
quests.accept_text: West along the road, north past the Fungal Vale, and west through Plaguewood. The gate's at the end of the road. Don't go in, whatever you hear.
quests.turn_in_text:
Then it's as bad as we thought.

The newcomers say they've seen cities like that in their dreams, burned and empty. I wish they hadn't.

quests.title: The Family Crypt
quests.description:
Edda Marris married into the family whose farm is still being worked by the dead. The Marris dead have a crypt under the stead, and Edda's heard they don't stay in their niches any more.

She wants the Crypt Shamblers put down and the Marris Ossuary Guards stopped, so the family can lie where they were put.
quests.accept_text: The stair down's at the stead, south of the farmhouse. It's laid out like a grid down there, so count your turns. The guards were the family's own men once, and they'll still try to stop you.
quests.turn_in_text:
Thank you. My husband's grandmother is down there somewhere, and I hope she's back where she belongs.

There's more, though. Something's still singing down there, and it isn't any hymn I know.

quests.title: The Sexton
quests.description:
Edda says the family's sexton buried every Marris for forty years and wouldn't stop when the plague came. Sexton Hollowell is still down there digging, and the dead he's buried sing for him.

She wants him put in the ground for good, and The Bone Choir silenced.
quests.accept_text: The sexton's hall is in the middle of the crypt, and the choir sings from the chapel at the head of it. You'll hear them both. Don't listen to the words, because they'll tell you to lie down.
quests.turn_in_text:
It's gone quiet down there. I didn't know how loud it was until it stopped.

I'll go down myself next week and say their names. Somebody in the family should, and I'm the only one of us left breathing.

quests.title: Gargoyles Over the Gates
quests.description:
Bat Handler Gwen Pike flies the Argent Dawn's bats between Light's Hope and the western road, and the Gate Gargoyles over Stratholme have started coming out to meet them. She's lost two bats this month.

She wants the Gate Gargoyles knocked out of the sky, and the Stone-Winged Gargoyles that hunt the open ground below them too.
quests.accept_text: The gate ones roost on Stratholme's walls at the top of the western road, and the wild ones hunt the open country under them. Bring them down where you can reach them, because they don't like to land.
quests.turn_in_text:
My bats'll fly the western road again. They're nervous animals and so am I, but we'll manage.

The gargoyles never used to come out this far. Something in that city's waking up.

quests.title: What Grew in the Jar
quests.description:
Yuki Hashimoto catalogues everything that grows back in Felwood, and she's had a jar of spores from the Fungal Vale on her bench for a week. They've grown, and they've grown into something she's never seen.

She wants Dr. Sun Li to see what her spores turn into.

objectives.label: Bring Yuki's jar to Dr. Sun Li at Crown Guard

quests.accept_text: Dr. Sun Li's at Crown Guard, in the east of the Eastern Plaguelands. It's a long way, so wrap the jar in something and keep it upright. It's started tapping on the glass, and I'd rather it didn't get out.
quests.turn_in_text:
Oh, that's beautiful, and I hate it.

I studied fungi in Kunming for twenty years, back home, and nothing ever moved on its own. Tell Yuki I owe her a very long letter, and come back when you've rested. The vale's worse than I thought.

on_accept.name: Yuki's Jar
on_accept.description: A sealed specimen jar wrapped in a scarf. Something pale inside it presses against the glass, and taps.
